text.en: OK to use after setting the app's unlimited approval to the deposit amount. Steakhouse's page, CoinGecko and the factory confirm the vault.
text.zh-TW: 可以用，但要先把 app 的無限授權改成存款額。Steakhouse 頁面、CoinGecko 和工廠都確認這個 vault。第一次先送小額。

text.en: Pulls the amount you type of USDC from the Safe with `transferFrom`
text.zh-TW: 用 `transferFrom` 從 Safe 拉走你填的金額的 USDC

text.en: Deposits the pulled USDC into this vault with `deposit`, which mints the shares to the Safe
text.zh-TW: 用 `deposit` 把拉來的 USDC 存進這個 vault，vault 把份額鑄給 Safe

text.en: The vault sends the USDC on to its liquidity adapter with `transfer`, which lends it on Morpho Blue
text.zh-TW: vault 用 `transfer` 把 USDC 轉給它的流動性 adapter，由 adapter 借到 Morpho Blue

pastTxsConclusion.en: Most misfits are the old Bundler3 route. Others deposited with an allowance given earlier, or approved another amount than they deposited, the newest of them unlimited. All are refused.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不符的多半是 Bundler3 舊路線；其餘用先前給的授權直接存，或授權額不等於存款額（最新幾筆是無限）。這些都不接受。

text.en: This vault is young and grew fast: it held almost nothing a year ago, rose several-fold in spring 2026, and has stayed large since. One holder owns about a fifth of the shares. The program's figures are in the Instance section.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 很年輕、長得很快：一年前幾乎是空的，2026 年春天翻了好幾倍，之後一直維持大規模。有一個持有人占約五分之一的份額。程式量到的數字在「實例」區。

recommendation.en: Send a small amount first. If one large holder leaves, a large withdrawal may have to wait.
recommendation.zh-TW: 先送小額。大戶離開時，大筆提款可能要等。

text.en: Your USDC does not stay in the vault: in the same transaction the vault hands it to its liquidity adapter, which supplies it to one Morpho Blue market, USDC lent against WBTC at 86% LLTV (block 26,490,392). An allocator can point it at another market at any time.
text.zh-TW: USDC 不會留在 vault 裡：同一筆交易中 vault 就把它交給流動性 adapter，adapter 再供應到一個 Morpho Blue 市場：以 WBTC 為抵押、LLTV 86% 的 USDC 市場（區塊 26,490,392）。allocator 隨時可以改成別的市場。

text.en: Through its one adapter the vault lends to 9 Morpho Blue USDC markets. Allocators move USDC between them within caps the curator sets per adapter, collateral and market, so the mix changes whenever they reallocate.
text.zh-TW: vault 透過唯一的 adapter 借給 9 個 Morpho Blue 的 USDC 市場。allocator 在策展人對 adapter、抵押品和市場設的上限內搬動 USDC，所以每次重新分配，組合就會變。

text.en: Three allocators can move funds between markets at any time, within the caps. The curator must wait 7 days to add an adapter or raise a cap, but can add an allocator, change the fees or set the withdrawal penalty at once.
text.zh-TW: 三個 allocator 隨時可以在上限內把資金搬到別的市場。策展人加 adapter 或調高上限要等 7 天，但新增 allocator、改手續費、設提款罰金可以立刻做。

title.zh-TW: 怎麼把 USDC 拿回來

text.en: Nothing sits idle, so a withdrawal is paid from the WBTC market the adapter supplies: about 47.6 million of the vault's 114.7 million USDC could leave that way (Morpho's API, 2026-11-25). Beyond that, wait for an allocator to move USDC back, or call `forceDeallocate` and pay its penalty (0.001% now; the curator can raise it to 2% at once).
text.zh-TW: vault 裡沒有閒置的 USDC，提款由 adapter 供應的 WBTC 市場支付：vault 的 1.147 億 USDC 中約 4,760 萬能這樣提出（Morpho 的 API，2026-11-25）。超過的部分要等 allocator 把 USDC 撤回，或呼叫 `forceDeallocate` 並付罰金（目前 0.001%，策展人可以立刻調高到 2%）。

role.en: USDC vault (V2, Prime Instant) managed by Steakhouse
role.zh-TW: Steakhouse 管理的 USDC vault（V2，Prime Instant）

text.zh-TW: Steakhouse 的 Prime Instant 文件頁在 Steakhouse Prime Instant USDC、Ethereum、Morpho v2 旁列出這個地址

text.en: Morpho's API (api.morpho.org/graphql), `vaultV2ByAddress` on chain 1, answers Steakhouse Prime USDC (steakUSDC), USDC asset, listed. The query names the address itself, so it does not count
text.zh-TW: Morpho 的 API（api.morpho.org/graphql）以 `vaultV2ByAddress` 查鏈 1，回答 Steakhouse Prime USDC（steakUSDC），資產 USDC，已上架。查詢本身帶了地址，所以不算一個來源

text.zh-TW: CoinGecko 的 steakhouse-usdc（Steakhouse USDC V2）列出這個地址
